display_title: The Weird Guy in Glasses Likes Me
mangabaka_title: The Weird Guy in Glasses Likes Me
description: Yun-seop is the perfect class representative, showered with the professor's favor, the love of his peers, and the respect of his juniors. He harbors a secret of relieving stress through masturbation, but he ends up being discovered by Kyung-dae, a junior who is usually quiet and gloomy. In exchange for keeping the secret, Kyung-dae demands that Yun-seop become his "sex partner," and the stimulation Kyung-dae offers soon begins to shake Yun-seop's heart...
